name: modwt
expr: wH = modwt(x, 'haar', 3); ws = modwt(xs, 'haar', 2); wd = modwt(xs, 'db2', 1); rec = imodwt(modwt(x,'sym4',4),'sym4'); rerr = max(abs(rec(:) - x(:)));
comment: Sig w=modwt(x,wname,lev): MODWT, (lev+1) x N. Now pins ACTUAL per-coefficient values (was energy-only): MODWT filters are wrev(Lo_D)/√2, wrev(Hi_D)/√2 applied as a look-back circular convolution — bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b (haar W_{1,1}=-3.5 via circular wrap 0.5*(x1-x8); scaling row [5.5 4.5 ...]; db2 W1=[0.732 2 -2.732]). Energy conservation + exact imodwt round-trip also pinned. Queue-clearing 2026-05-29: fixed the per-coefficient alignment/boundary that the old energy-only spec couldn't catch.
